a: $1,000, free ECS meeting student registration and up to $1,000 meeting travel; up to two awards a year
dt: Nomination period Oct 15 - Jan 15, annually; this cycle closes Jan 15, 2027
e: Recognizes students doing research on electrochemical power sources (batteries and fuel cells). Nominees must be ECS and Battery Division members and enrolled at a college or university at the deadline; the package includes transcripts, achievements, a two-page research statement and a supervisor letter.
n: ECS Battery Division Student Research Award
unv: The page gives the annual Oct 15 - Jan 15 window; the 2027 closing date is taken from that annual window.
